findings.pdf_says: The size of the current record is determined by rules specified in the RECORD clause. If the file description entry contains a RECORD IS VARYING clause, the implied move is a group move. The implied MOVE statement
findings.markdown_says: <u>The size of the current record is determined by rules specified in the RECORD clause. ║If the file description entry contains a RECORD IS VARYING clause, the implied move is a group move.</u>║ The implied MOVE statement
findings.explanation: The printed page has no underlining in this rule. The lines the transcription read as underlining are the staircase border of the change box, which starts mid-line at 'If the file description entry...' (its top edge runs over the end of the line 'The size of the current record is determined by rules', and its lower-left step runs under 'specified in the RECORD clause.'). The ║ box markers are placed correctly. The <u>...</u> markup is spurious and should be removed, which also fixes the bad nesting of </u> inside the box span.
findings.why_it_matters: Spurious underlining in prose adds emphasis the standard does not print and mis-nests with the change-box markers; it does not alter the rule text.
